notes.title: Update Information Ver. 1.0.3 (2016.4.27)
notes.content:
An update to Nobunaga's Ambition: Souzou SengokuRisshiden has been released.
The update will be applied automatically when you restart the game. 

Improvements:
 - Added an initial settings item
 - Enhanced the functions of some commands
 - Enhanced the visuals of the UI
 - Adjusted the flow of gameplay

Balance Adjustments:
 - Adjusted the balance of, for example, the amount of resources

Bug Fixes:
 - Fixed a bug concerning the flow of gameplay
 - Fixed a bug concerning an algorithm
 - Fixed a bug concerning Quests
 - Fixed other bugs and corrected typographical errors
